notes: Counting follows the element-boundary rule in 01-MASTER-BRIEF.md §11 (as amended by WP-B: a run
of consecutive, vertically stacked, horizontally overlapping IN-FLOW siblings). An absolutely
positioned block always starts its own element, otherwise every real slide would be a single text
element (its top-level blocks are all position:absolute siblings of <body>).
Shapes: 1 for mark.hl (a non-atomic inline box, painted per client rect), and 3 chips painted
once each, by the element walk, from their border boxes.
Atomic inline boxes with horizontal geometry of their own — padding, a margin, a column wider than
its text — are detached (WP-B R3): each becomes its own text element over its own shape, and the
text on either side becomes a hugged segment. That holds whatever the spaces around the box: the
'chips' row has real spaces on both sides, but a run cannot carry a chip's 10 px of padding, so
kept inline every word after a chip moved left by it, under the next chip. The row is four text
elements (all on one line, none stacked); the space between the two chips measures no line.
Nested lists are deliberately absent — see README.md §Deliberate omissions.
Line counts were measured in Edge with the master's theme fonts forced (Calibri / Calibri Light);
a different theme font re-breaks them, the paragraph counts are structural and do not move.

gateMaxPx2 971 = max(measured x 1.2, measured + 60) over the measured 809 px2 masked non-chart area on fidelity-w3 (2314d7f), 2026-09-25 (plan §11; Peter #16: measured + 20 %, with the 60 px2 per-slide noise tolerance as the floor). A regression guard, not a target.
Lone lines (fidelity r1c, 2026-09-25): five one-line elements whose line-height is at or above 1.2 em,
PowerPoint's single spacing, where it sets an exact line about a quarter of the leading higher than
PptxRender (a client deck's operators and pseudo's chevrons: 10 px). The emitter writes each at its glyphs' own
height, shortened by whole pixels (text._fit_lone_line: 20 / 14 / 13 / 24 / 11 px for Calibri, whose
hhea height is 1 em), so PptxRender draws them on the pixels it drew before and PowerPoint agrees.
text +5 and shape +2 (the chevron's fill, the counter's circle); the masked area stays 809 px2.
A change of leading (fidelity r2, 2026-09-25): 'kpi-leading' stacks a 26 px bold number at line-height 1
over a 12 px bold label at 22 px. text._exact_gap keeps the label's baseline the browser's distance under
the number's; the old gap, Δc − (L1 + L2)/2, put it 7 px low in PptxRender (the masked area was 1,876 px2
with the old gap, +1,067 for this case alone). text +1; the masked area stays 809 px2.
